items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: my brother had an orchestra in Memphis, Tennessee. Well, they broke up and they come up in Mississippi. And he asked me would I join them. So he learned me a lot.

ctx.x: And so I'd just run around from one to another and one from another. Those guys would go to plays to play music. I'd ask the one to let me carry his instrument for him. I'd go to the dance with him, carry his instrument. When they stopped for intermission, I'd grab one of them and go to play in it. Yeah. So finally, I got good enough for the make a couple of songs of my own. And then I'd start playing for country suppers myself, getting $3 and $4 an hour for playing at those suppers.
